$comment: Share images, social posts and banners, from the agd-playground image editor at /inkbox (src/components/inkbox-og: draw.ts, app.ts, brand.ts, content.ts, layouts.ts; the routes inkbox-og-image, inkbox-social-posts, inbox-social-posts and inkbox-banner all redirect there). The layout rules are the engine's (src/assets/share.ts, the editor's drawDesign kept in its own terms); this file holds the brand's part: colors as token names, themes, sizes, templates, occasions and their copy, and the window's placeholder content. Every hex the editor drew is a token here (see notes); where it had none, the nearest token by color difference is used.
notes: Tokens win where the editor and tokens.css disagree. Headlines: the editor set Funnel Display SemiBold; --ds-font-display is Inter, so headlines are Inter SemiBold (600, --ds-font-weight-semibold). The new-feature card's IBM Plex Sans is Inter too; its mono pill and footer stay IBM Plex Mono (--ds-font-mono).
Ink #3c2c52 and the mist ink #3f2a53 are ink (#3E2A53); purple #74629d is brand; the violet #816daa (tiles, pills) is brand (#74629D); pink #f9b1b4 is pink (#F9B1B5).
Paper #f8fbff is white. Mist #e7eff9 is tag-gray (#EDF2F7) and its line #c4cfe4 is border-default (#D2C9DB). Lavender #f2e2ff is tag-purple (#E9D8FD). Deep #2f2438 is ink (no darker purple token).
The lilac line #beaeda (hatching, outlines, guides, frames) and the lavender line #c9b4e6 are text-faint (#BCB3C5), the nearest token; it is a little grayer than the editor's lilac.

The window is the console, so its colors are the console's tokens: strong #2f2438 is ink, nav #5d4d67 is icon-secondary (#5B4C6A), muted #8679a3 is text-muted (#998EA5), accent #7f69b0 is brand, tint #f4f2f7 and the second rail #f8f7fb are lilac (#F4F2F6), hairlines #ece8f2 are border-subtle (#F3F1F5), the avatar #4f6bed is avatar (#5063B1), the unread tag #dbe8fe and #3b6fd8 are tag-blue and tag-blue-fg, the BETA tag's #fff7f7 is white.
Browser chrome: #f6f4f9 is lilac; the three dots #f2b8b5, #f5d99a, #bfe3b4 are pink, status-warning-bg and status-success-bg; the address ink #8679a3 is text-muted.
Shadows: the editor's rgba(47,36,56,a) uses the ink token at the same alpha.
The window's placeholder mailbox is Acme: the editor's sample messages named a real person and handle, so none of them ship.
The editor's console screens (public/inkbox-og/screens) are labelled placeholders, so they are not shipped; pass --image for a real capture in the window.
A pasted X post becomes a headline with the author as a small credit in the editor; here pass --headline and --credit (an Acme placeholder in examples, never a real post, name or avatar).
Left out: the Y Combinator badge (the orange Y square is a third-party mark), the orange highlight that matched it (#f97316 has no token), the claim in words, and the X mark beside the card's handle.

Only the words that were asked for are drawn. The occasions' words are samples (Acme) and are drawn with --sample only. The lockup, the brand's own handle and address (card) and the address over the console (feature) stay.
The console in the window is a picture of the product with Acme placeholder mail (brand/illustration.md rule 14). --console blank draws it without messages; --image puts your own capture there.

Highlights: pink on white is 1.75:1, so on the light themes the highlighted words are rose (#8C5659), the token tokens.css names as the pink's dark partner; on purple and deep they stay pink. Lilac is 2.0:1 on white, so it is brand there, and border-default on purple; violet on purple is pink and on deep text-faint. The pink stays in the badge's dot, which is not a word.

The line under the headline was the ink at 78 percent: it is the nearest token that reads at 4.5:1, text-secondary on white, icon-secondary on mist and lavender, white on purple, border-default on deep.
The outline band cut its letters at the canvas's sides and 9.84 units under its foot: the band now fades at both ends and its letters stand on the foot. The wordmark tile draws whole wordmarks only.

Sizes: the shared ids and pixels (src/design/platforms.ts, with what each platform covers, its upload limit and their sources); li-square is the editor's own. The editor's card (1200 by 675) is landscape, its li-page (1128 by 191) is linkedin-page (1512 by 256, the same shape) and its email header is 1200 by 400.
The pill on the purple theme is the ink at 20 percent: white words on white at 14 percent over the purple were 3.96:1. The deep theme keeps the white tint.
logoAnchors: where the lockup may be put in each template (and slide), the places where it keeps its clear space from every part at every size; measured by drawing each, not chosen by hand.

tile.label: Tile
tile.description: The words top left, a panel of the wordmark tiled beside or under them, the sitting octopus on it, and the lockup.

app.label: Product
app.description: The words over (beside, on a banner) the console's inbox in a window, the octopus hanging over its edge, the reef behind. The window fades into the ground where it does not fit.

outline.label: Outline
outline.description: Centered words over a band of huge outlined wordmarks that fades at both ends, hatched strips down the sides, the octopus hanging over the rule.

hatch.label: Hatched
hatch.description: Words set right over (beside, on a banner) a hatched floor, the octopus hanging over its edge.

reef.label: Reef
reef.description: The lockup, the words, the sitting octopus and the reef along the bottom.

feature.label: Feature
feature.description: Words with a badge over (beside, on a banner) the console in a browser window, inside a hatched border. The window fades out before the border.

partner.label: Lockup
partner.description: The lockup, beside a partner's name when one is given, over centered words, on a staggered wordmark tile inside a line border.

funding.label: Big number
funding.description: A very large headline (a number) over the outline band and hatched sides, the octopus hanging over the rule.

announce.label: Announcement
announce.description: Words with a dot badge inside a solid purple border, the lockup and the sitting octopus.

card.label: Card
card.description: The new-feature card: the lockup top left, the badge as a solid pill top right, the words centered between, and the brand's handle and address in a mono footer.

mark.label: Lockup
mark.description: The lockup alone on the theme's ground (the octopus alone in a profile picture). It draws no words.
